title: Validate synchronization state
scope: Validate fence/timeline ownership and submit/wait/signal interleavings.
acceptance: Host mock tests cover wait-before-signal, pending reuse, failed submit and device teardown.
Valid asynchronous schedules pass without accidental serialization requirements.
evidence: Windows VS 18 Release: cmake --build build-d3d12-baseline --config Release --target parallel-mater-layer-validation-tests; focused validation/plain CTest pair passed 2/2.
Windows VS 17 2022 CUDA+D3D12 Release: the focused validation/plain CTest pair passed 2/2 after compiling the updated layer and mock driver.

Host mock regression covers cross-device timelines, invalid scopes, same-submit cycles, failed-submit retry, consumer-before-producer, precise fence/timeline completion, deferred failure, counter observation, pending reuse and device teardown.
